title: OpenAI ships a teen ChatGPT
angle: Read it as legal strategy, not product strategy.

frames.text: OpenAI just shipped a teen version of ChatGPT.
Ages 13 to 17, with learning tools and optional parental controls.
Romantic roleplay, graphic violence, self-harm. Tighter limits throughout.
State attorneys general taking Meta to trial over youth harm.
This isn't a product launch. It's a liability launch.
Better they build the guardrails now than have a court write them.
